tell: A culture that builds high takes the dry ridge and a culture that builds low takes the sheltered hollow by the water, out of the same ground.
score: 2.5 * (1 - clamp(parcel.slope, 0, 8) / 8) + lerp(0.2, 3.0, gene.elevation_bias) * (1 - field.flood) + lerp(0.1, 1.2, gene.elevation_bias) * field.exposure + lerp(0.1, 1.0, gene.aperture_ratio) * field.sun + lerp(0.1, 1.5, 1 - gene.roof_pitch) * (1 - field.snow) + 0.8 * (1 - field.damp) - 0.35 * clamp(parcel.water - 3, 0, 12) - lerp(0.1, 0.8, gene.communal_ratio) * parcel.hearth
